checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Poster, story and reel all display exactly '24 October 2027'
must.why: Both images and all four sampled frames of the revised reel read 24 October 2027. At 9.5 s the reel crops the date edges.

must.item: Old date '17 October 2027' absent from both images and every reel frame
must.why: No 17 October appears in the revised images or in the four sampled frames of the revised reel.

must.item: All three retain 'Rooftop Jazz', '7 PM', 'Atlas Roof', 'Free entry' unaltered
must.why: The text reads correctly in the images and reel frames. The title is pushed out of frame by the zoom at 7 s and 9.5 s.

must.item: Revised assets preserve original design, imagery and layout apart from the date
must.why: Palette, art, and layout match the originals. Only the date changed, and it shifted slightly in position.

must.item: Final pack has two separate images and one 10-second reel in requested aspect ratios
must.why: The pack has a 9:16 story image, a 4:5 poster and a 10 s 474×864 vertical reel.

faults.what: The reel's push-in is strong. By 9.5 s the date is clipped at the left and right edges ("24 October 2027" is cut off) and the title is cut off at the top.
The reel's last frames lose the framing and most of the border, so it looks less like the story image.
The date text is slightly wider and shifted compared with the original. The other text is the same.
The assistant did not check the outputs and told the user to verify them. The reel has some compression softness.

summary: The two images are correctly updated to 24 October 2027 with everything else preserved, and the reel shows the new date throughout, but its push-in crops the date and title at the end.
